title: xanthophytum fruticulosum var. ferrugineum
intro: Xanthophytum fruticulosum var. ferrugineum, commonly known as Java tea or Javanese bay tree, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to Indonesia and Malaysia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cognitive function, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents present in Xanthophytum fruticulosum var. ferrugineum include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits and therapeutic actions of Java tea make it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
